title: The kb-census skill's report names the dns and connect hosts beside the blocked ones and gives detect's measured wall time
goal: The kb-census skill's report line names the hosts census.py summary counts as dns and connect, apart from blocked, and phase 0 gives factdiff.py detect --sitemaps the measured 31 to 33 minutes of 2026-10-10 (the fact-diff report) instead of about 45.
